name: qmh-topic-experts
description: Local Codex topic experts for the PPE Quantitative Methods for Humanities course, including optional R, probability with introductory inference, causal inference, and linear regression.

interface.shortDescription: Course experts for optional R, probability/inference, causality, and regression.
interface.longDescription: Provides four local Codex skills that act as reusable topic experts for creating, reviewing, and grading PPE Quantitative Methods for Humanities course materials. The 2026-27 probability expert includes introductory hypothesis testing, p-values, confidence intervals, and comparison of means.
defaultPrompt: Use the relevant QMH topic expert to draft an exam question.
Use the probability expert to draft a probability or introductory hypothesis-testing question.
Consult the QMH topic experts while reviewing this problem set.
Use the QMH topic experts to align grading guidance with the course.
